note: Pre-registered split configurations. gold_standard.split refuses a config that is absent here, whose recomputed content_sha256 differs from the registered one, or whose body is marked runnable:false. PROP:1431 requires the enlargement rule to be fixed before the final benchmark and recorded in a version log; this file plus DATA/gold_standard/splits/version_log.jsonl are that record.

body.origin: proposal-origin, verbatim (PROP:1431): 'dibagi secara group-aware menjadi 60% training set (720 kalimat), 20% development set (240 kalimat), dan 20% held-out test set (240 kalimat)'
body.rationale: The proposal IS the pre-registration. CONFIG_A2 is measurably better on CI width but editing a verbatim pre-registered number for an unmeasurable gain is the worse liability, so A2 is registered and not run.

body.origin: code-origin optimisation, registered UN-RUN so the record shows it was computed before the data was opened and deliberately not taken
body.rationale: Local slope of the measured learning curve (0.468-0.424)/720 = 6.1e-5 F1/sentence, so moving 120 sentences out of train costs 0.0073 F1, four times inside the 0.030 seed spread, while the test CI at F1=0.5 narrows from 0.109 to 0.089. Rejected as primary because it edits a verbatim pre-registered number (PROP:1431).

body.origin: code-origin; the enlarged configuration ENLARGE_R2 allocates to
body.rationale: Measured curve gives +0.045 F1 from 720->1440 and +0.0035 from 1440->2880, the latter inside the 0.030 seed spread, so one doubling of the train split is the largest defensible enlargement. Nested: Config B's test must be a strict superset of Config A's test, so an enlargement can only add evidence and can never re-draw a luckier test set.
body.requires: ENLARGE_R1 trigger on train+dev adjudicated gold; test never opened

body.origin: trigger is proposal-origin (PROP:1431: a five-tag label with support too small to evaluate meaningfully on the held-out test set, enlarged BEFORE the test set is frozen, under a rule fixed before the final benchmark and logged in the version log); the NUMBER is code-origin
body.trigger: any of SH/SS/KN/TT/WB with projected test span support < 120, projected from the adjudicated TRAIN+DEV gold only, test never opened
body.derivation: gold_standard.iaa.CI_WIDTH_CLAIMABLE=0.20 -> N >= 4*1.96^2*0.25/0.04 = 96.04 spans at worst-case p=0.5, x DEFF 1.18 = 113.3 -> 120
body.caveat: no numeric support threshold exists in the proposal or in Paket B v3, which assigns it to the researcher (B3:32)

body.rationale: Cap at 2,400 (1,440/480/480) because the measured learning curve's 1440->2880 gain (+0.0035) is inside the 0.030 seed spread. Enlargement must be NESTED: extend_split asserts by row-level sha that no base sentence changed part.
